cases.d: Switch calendar views and open a meeting.
steps: Switch between Tuần làm việc, Cả tuần, Tháng and Danh sách; click Hôm nay and move between weeks.
Click a meeting to see its overview, then open its detail.
exp: Meetings appear at their local times in each view; today is highlighted.
The overview shows time, Hình thức, Địa điểm and Chủ tọa.
pre: The user has meetings across several weeks.

cases.d: Calendar filters by status and sensitivity; restricted meetings stay hidden.
steps: Open "Bộ lọc", choose a status and Mức độ, tick "Gồm cả cuộc họp nháp".
exp: Only matching meetings remain; with none, "Không có cuộc họp nào khớp bộ lọc trong khoảng này.".
Meetings the user may not see never appear.

cases.d: An invitee answers from the calendar.
steps: As thanhvien, open a published meeting in the calendar.
At "Xác nhận tham dự?" choose to attend.
exp: The answer is saved and the calendar entry shows it.
pre: thanhvien is invited to a published meeting that has not been answered.
